integrity: The theorem includes a self-contained all-parameter proof and an executable, finite exact-rational consistency checker. Finite checks do not replace proof or independently establish historical priority.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is restricted to unweighted complete graphs, vertex Euclidean input perturbations and quadratic edge output variation, with fractional exponent strictly between zero and one. Independent bibliographic priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Sharp two-input energy stability and activation jumps for fractional maximal averaging on cliques
